## Review Notes

- No stock photography, third-party illustrations, icon sets, or downloaded font files ship in MVP-05..07.
- Template preview artwork is original CSS composition. It does not embed or derive from external image assets.
- Future image or font additions require source URL, author, license, attribution requirement, and use scope in this document before use.
